product.title: Private Car Tour to see Highlights of Kamakura, Enoshima, Yokohama from Tokyo

description.text: In Tokyo, this private 10-hour car outing covers Kamakura, Enoshima, and Yokohama with a guide and driver instead of three separate train days. The published list covers the Kotoku-in Great Buddha, coastal Enoshima stops, and Yokohama waterfront sights, with the operator helping choose a stop list that fits the window. Private transportation is included; meals stay separate. The route stays on the Miura coast and Yokohama harbor rather than a Mount Fuji transfer. The format suits visitors who want a guided coastal-heritage day without assembling Kamakura and Enoshima tickets independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Tokyo, and the itinerary stays on Kamakura, Kotoku-in, Enoshima, and Yokohama that define this outing rather than a Nikko shrine circuit.
